## Procedure
Use numbered actions with observable results and clear stop conditions. Keep units,
labels, output location and the effect of each control explicit.

## Failure and recovery
State safe stop/abort behavior, data preservation, incident recording and escalation.
Software controls cannot override the physical E-stop or independent safeguards.

## Verification and change control
Link evidence for this procedure, required daily checks and recalibration triggers.
Do not claim synthetic checks validate placement, exposure, timing or calibration.
